Name: Dathan
Summary: Dathan, son of Eliab, joined Korah's rebellion against Moses and Aaron and refused to come up when Moses summoned him.
KeyStory: Dathan stood at the door of his tent with his family as the ground opened and swallowed the rebels alive.
RelatedPeople: Abiram; Eliab, Son of Pallu; Korah, Son of Izhar; Moses; Aaron
LifeLesson: Refusing God's appointed leadership is refusing God Himself.
